Warmbly v0.3.0: An open-source alternative to cold email and email warmup services like Apollo, Mailreach, Instantly. Now with built-in forms, segments and bug fixes.
Hi everyone!

Warmbly v0.3.0 is finally here. It's an open-source cold email and email warmup service where you have to connect YOUR OWN mailboxes and we run your campaigns at scale with built-in warmup. It's an alternative to services like Apollo, Mailreach, Instantly

Cloud version coming really soon (this fall) with free warmup pool access. It's worth subscribing to our waitlist.

New features in v0.3.0:

* Index page visuals 1/1 with the dashboard, hero pricing line, Discord links ([\#268](https://github.com/warmbly/warmbly/issues/268)) ([\#289](https://github.com/warmbly/warmbly/pull/289))
* Forms v2 with themes, layouts, pages, personalized links, funnel analytics, campaign integration and a custom forms domain ([\#287](https://github.com/warmbly/warmbly/pull/287))
* Live segment-to-campaign linking, lead removal, and import targeting (issue [\#277](https://github.com/warmbly/warmbly/issues/277)) ([\#284](https://github.com/warmbly/warmbly/pull/284))
* Fix implicit-TLS SMTP on 465 and IMAP STARTTLS on 143 behind a stored per-mailbox security mode that accepts any port… ([\#283](https://github.com/warmbly/warmbly/pull/283))
* Make the per-mailbox daily campaign cap configurable up to 5,000/day ([\#280](https://github.com/warmbly/warmbly/pull/280))
* Surface the segment ID in the dashboard and docs for segment API integrators ([\#279](https://github.com/warmbly/warmbly/pull/279))
* Contact segments (saved audiences) with live SQL evaluation, manual overrides and one-step campaign enrolment ([\#270](https://github.com/warmbly/warmbly/pull/270))
* Self-hosted instances warm their mailboxes in the hosted pool (Warmbly Cloud link) ([\#262](https://github.com/warmbly/warmbly/pull/262))

(copied from github, and several more bug fixes)

In our first month, we've reached 95+ GitHub stars and 75+ waitlist members, along with a growing group of users, self-hosters, and contributors who have helped with development and testing. Thank you!

  
Website: [https://warmbly.com](https://warmbly.com)  
Github: [https://github.com/warmbly/warmbly](https://github.com/warmbly/warmbly)
